title: Color Harmony Generator
description: Build complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic and split-complementary palettes from any base color using real HSL math.
howto: Five harmony rules generate instantly: complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, split-complementary.
Click any swatch to copy its HEX code.

faqs.a: A set of colors spaced by fixed angles on the color wheel (hue circle). Harmonies look balanced because the spacing follows geometric rules.
Your color is converted to HSL, the hue is rotated by the rule angle (e.g. +180° for complementary), then converted back to HEX. Saturation and lightness are preserved.
Complementary for bold contrast, analogous for calm cohesion, triadic/tetradic for vibrant variety, split-complementary for strong-but-safe contrast.
